pages.ja:
交差する二つの凶器。
双剣と長槍、両者の得物は互いの首を討とうと繰り出される。
そこに間断はなく、容赦はない。
放つ一撃は全て必殺の意思によるもの。

pages.en:
Two murderous weapons cross.

Twin swords and a long spear—each reaches for the throat of the man opposite.

There is no pause between them, and no mercy.

Every blow is struck with the will to kill.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The two weapons clash.
Twin swords and lance: the attacks are executed to take their wielders’ necks.
There’s no hesitation in those attacks.
Each strike is meant to kill.

pages.ja:
ランサーとて例外ではない。
協力者である遠坂凛に“手を抜く”と言っても、いざ戦いが始まればそんなものは二の次だ。
手加減なぞ、放った槍が偶々心臓を外れ、即死でなかったのならトドメは刺さない、という次元の話にすぎない。
そうなれば絶命するが、要は死ぬまでに遠坂凛の前に引きずっていけばいいだけの話。
その後の事などランサーの知った事ではない。

pages.en:
Lancer is no exception.

He may have promised his ally, Rin Tohsaka, that he would “hold back,” but once battle begins, that concern comes second.

His restraint extends no further than this: should his spear happen to miss Archer's heart, leaving him alive rather than killing him instantly, Lancer will not administer the final blow.

Archer will still die. Lancer need only drag him to Rin Tohsaka and let her speak to him first.

What happens afterward is none of Lancer's concern.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Even Lancer makes no exceptions.
Even though he told Tohsaka Rin, his ally, that he would “go easy”, that becomes secondary once the battle starts.
It merely means that if his lance happens to miss Archer’s heart and if it does not kill him instantly, he will refrain from finishing Archer off on the spot.
Even in that case, his enemy will
die,
die in due time,
but Lancer just needs to drag him to Tohsaka Rin before that happens.
Lancer does not care what happens after that.

pages.ja:
「っ
！」
朱色の魔槍が、敵の領域を侵犯する。
繰り出される槍は回を増すごとにアーチャーの守りを崩す。
いつぞやの戦いとは違う。
あの夜防ぎきったランサーの槍を、アーチャーは捌ききれない。

pages.en:
“—Ghh!”

The crimson demonic spear tears into its enemy's guard.

With every thrust, Archer's defense crumbles further.

This is nothing like their battle before.

The spear Archer weathered that night now outstrips his ability to parry it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
The red demonic lance invades the enemy territory.
The lance breaks through Archer’s defense each time it is thrust.
It is not like that night.
Archer cannot block Lancer’s attacks now as he could then.

pages.ja:
それも当然。
これは二度目の戦いだ。
ランサーにはある令呪が働いている。
敵マスターの戦力を知る為、彼のマスターはランサーにこう告げた。
「おまえは全員と戦え。だが倒すな。一度目の相手からは必ず生還しろ」
自身に科せられたただ一つの命令。
そんな馬鹿げた命令に従った彼に、ようやく訪れた“何の縛りもない戦い”がこれである。

pages.en:
And rightly so.

This is their second battle.

Lancer had been laboring under a Command Spell. To learn the strength of the other Masters, his own Master had ordered him:

“Fight every one of them. But defeat none. Whatever happens, return alive from your first encounter with each.”

It was the sole command laid upon him.

Having obeyed that absurd order, he has at last been granted a battle without restraints.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It is only natural.
This is their second battle.
Lancer was under the Command Spell’s bind.
To learn his enemies’ strengths, his Master told Lancer,
“Fight against everyone. But do not defeat them. Survive your first battle against any opponent.”
That is the only order he was given.
He has followed such an unreasonable command, and this is his first “battle without any binds”.

pages.ja:
故に、前回と同じである筈がない。
ランサーを縛るものは何もなく、アーチャーはここにきて、サーヴァント中最速の英霊と戦う事になった。
pages.jaRuby:
故に、前回と同じである筈がない。
ランサーを縛るものは何もなく、アーチャーはここにきて、サーヴァント中最速の英霊と戦う事になった。
pages.en:
It cannot possibly unfold as the first did.

Nothing binds Lancer now, and Archer finds himself facing the fastest of the Heroic Spirits.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Therefore, it cannot be like the last battle.
There is nothing binding Lancer, and Archer is now forced to fight the fastest heroic spirit.

pages.ja:
「ぬっ
！」
二度、アーチャーから苦悶が漏れる。
ランサーの槍は、彼の鷹の目を持ってしても視認できる物ではなくなっていた。
もとより点にすぎない槍の軌跡。
それが、今では閃光と化している。
迫り来る槍の穂先が見えぬ。
得物を振るう腕の動き、その足捌きさえ、既に不可視の領域に加速しつつあった。

pages.en:
“Ngh—!”

Twice, a groan escapes Archer.

Even his hawk's eyes can no longer follow Lancer's spear.

Its path was scarcely more than a point to begin with. Now even that has become a streak of light.

The spearhead bearing down upon him is invisible. The arm wielding it, even the movement of Lancer's feet, are accelerating beyond the bounds of sight.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Guh!”
A strained voice escapes Archer’s mouth.
Even his hawk-like eyes cannot follow Lancer’s spear.
The lance’s movement is a point to start with.
And it is a flash of light now.
He cannot discern the lance coming at him.
Even Lancer’s movements are becoming invisible now.

pages.ja:
「
っ」
それをここまで防ぎきったのは、前回の戦いでランサーの槍を知ったからだ。
彼は今の自分に出来る事
白兵戦でランサーに劣っている、という事実のみを武器にして猛攻を捌いていた。
いうなれば攻撃箇所の調整である。
赤い外套の騎士は、自ら致命的な隙を作る事で攻撃を限定させる。

っ」

pages.en:
“——”

Archer has held out this long only because their previous battle taught him Lancer's spear.

He turns the one fact available to him—that he is inferior to Lancer in close combat—into a weapon, and with it endures the onslaught.

He is, in effect, choosing where Lancer will strike.

The knight in red deliberately exposes fatal openings, constraining his opponent's attacks.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
He has been able to block such attacks until now because he had experienced them in a previous battle.
He is doing what he canusing his inferiority as a weapon to block Lancer’s furious onslaught.
He is controlling where the attacks come.
The knight in red limits the oncoming attacks by leaving fatal openings.

pages.ja:
無論、それを躱せねば死あるのみだ。
だが、即死を避けるあまり全身に傷を負い死に至るのならば、五体が満足のままの即死を選んだ。
そうでなければここまでした意味がない。
幸い、ランサーは未だアーチャーを侮っている。
いや、単純に戦闘そのものに没頭している。
このまま能力差だけで殺し合うというのなら、考え得るだけで三十通りは“隙を見せる”事ができる。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Of course, if he fails to evade one, he dies.

But if protecting himself from instant death would only leave wounds across his body until they killed him, he would sooner gamble on a single fatal stroke while his limbs remain whole.

Otherwise, all he has done would be meaningless.

Fortunately, Lancer still underestimates him.

No—he has simply lost himself in the battle.

So long as they continue killing each other by ability alone, Archer can devise at least thirty openings to offer him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Of course, he will die if he does not dodge the attacks.
But if he can choose between instant death and getting slowly cut up, he prefers to risk instant death.
Otherwise, it all will have been for nothing.
Fortunately, Lancer is still taking Archer lightly.
Or rather, he is lost in the joy of battle.
If they are to keep on assaulting each other like this, he can think of another thirty ways to “show an opening”.

pages.ja:
前回に得た情報を元にした行動予測と、培ってきた戦闘経験による状況打破。
それが『心眼』と呼ばれる、修練によって得られる鉄の心だ。
それは非凡な物などでは断じてない。
彼の持つ唯一の技術。
セイバーの持つ『直感』のような先天的な物ではなく、愚直なまでに修練を重ねれば誰にでも手が届く、凡人故の武器だった。

pages.en:
He predicts Lancer's actions from what he learned in their first encounter, then uses the combat experience amassed over a lifetime to escape the situation before him.

This is the iron composure called the Mind's Eye, acquired through discipline.

There is nothing extraordinary about it.

It is the one skill that is truly his.

Unlike Saber's Instinct, it is no gift of birth. It is the weapon of an ordinary man—something anyone might grasp if only they endured enough stubborn, unglamorous training.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Prediction using the information obtained. Planning using cultivated battle experience.
Those are the nerves of steel, the “mind’s eye” that one obtains through training.
This is nothing extraordinary.
This is the only skill he possesses.
It is not innate like Saber’s “instinct”, but it is a simple weapon that anyone can gain through hard work.

pages.ja:
「
」
槍を翻し、わずか、ランサーは足を止めた。
どうも納得がいかぬ、と赤い弓兵を観察する。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」

どうも納得がいかぬ、と赤い弓兵を観察する。
pages.en:
“——”

Lancer wheels his spear and, for the briefest moment, stills his feet.

Something does not sit right with him. He studies the red bowman.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
Lancer backs off and stops for a bit.
He looks the red archer over, as though dissatisfied.

pages.ja:
勝敗はもはや明らかだ。
白兵戦ではアーチャーに勝ち目はない。
そんな事は判りきっていた事だ。
アーチャーがその名の通り“弓兵”であるのなら、遠距離からの狙撃でなくては勝負にさえなりはしない。
だが、それを防いだ。
とうに劣勢、あと数合も保つまいが、それでも本気になった自分の槍を受けきった。
pages.jaRuby:
勝敗はもはや明らかだ。

だが、それを防いだ。
とうに劣勢、あと数合も保つまいが、それでも本気になった自分の槍を受けきった。
pages.en:
The outcome is already plain.

In close combat, Archer has no chance of victory. That was never in question.

If Archer is, as his name declares, a bowman, then only a long-range shot could make this anything resembling a contest.

And yet he defended himself.

He has long since been driven onto the back foot and cannot last more than a few exchanges, but he nevertheless endured Lancer's spear at full strength.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It is obvious who is going to win.
Archer has no chance of victory in hand-to-hand combat.
That has been obvious from the start.
If Archer is an “archer” like his name states, this cannot be a match unless he’s shooting from a long range.
But still, he blocked the attacks.
He is inferior and should not last a few more blows, but he blocked Lancer’s full-force attacks.

pages.ja:
ヤツが強いのか、それともオレが手を抜いているのか。
ふん、と鼻で笑う。
アーチャーは得体の知れないサーヴァントだ。
その点において、ヤツが強い、というのは認めるべきだ。
pages.jaRuby:
ヤツが強いのか、それともオレが手を抜いているのか。

その点において、ヤツが強い、というのは認めるべきだ。
pages.en:
—Is he that strong, or am I still holding back?

Lancer snorts.

Archer is a Servant of uncertain nature. In that respect, Lancer must concede that the man is strong.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Is Archer strong, or is Lancer going easy on him?
He laughs.
Archer is a mysterious Servant.
He can admit that Archer is strong in that regard.

pages.ja:
だが
自分が手を抜いている、というのは心外だ。
一合目はヤツの顔ごと吹き飛ばすつもりで首を狙った。
二合目は肋ごと粉砕するつもりで心臓を払った。
手を抜いている筈はない。
筈はないが
確かに、殺す気ではなかったか。
pages.jaRuby:
だが
自分が手を抜いている、というのは心外だ。
一合目はヤツの顔ごと吹き飛ばすつもりで首を狙った。

pages.en:
But the notion that he himself is holding back is an insult.

His first stroke went for Archer's neck, intending to take the man's head with it.

His second swept at the heart, intending to shatter every rib in its path.

He cannot be holding back.

And yet—

—It is true. He had not meant to kill him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Butit is unthinkable for Lancer to be going easy.
The first attack was aimed at the neck to chop his head off.
The second attack was aimed at the heart to destroy his body.
He cannot be going easy.
He shouldn’t be, but
It is certainly true that he wasn’t trying to kill Archer.

pages.ja:
このような戦闘で本気になったところで何がある。
サーヴァントの戦いは、つまるところ宝具の戦いだ。
必殺であるソレを出さずに追い詰める事こそ手を抜いている証拠。
その理由。
その原因は、つい先ほど耳にした、なんでもない礼らしい。
“
チッ。まったく、本気かオレは
！”
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
What would it mean to fight seriously in a battle such as this?

In the end, a battle between Servants is a battle between Noble Phantasms.

Cornering Archer without unleashing his sure-kill weapon is itself proof that Lancer is holding back.

And the reason—the cause—appears to be one commonplace word of thanks he heard only moments ago.

“—Tch. Damn it, what am I doing—!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
How does one know that this sort of fight is serious?
A battle between Servants is a battle between Noble Phantasms.
The fact that he is fighting Archer without using his is proof that he is going easy on him.
The reason behind it…
…Must be the “thanks” he heard earlier.
“Damn. Are you kidding me!?”

pages.ja:
「くっ
！」
「づっ
！」
一際高い剣戟。
舞い散る火花と共に、両者の体が後退する。
自身に叩きつけるようなランサー渾身の一撃は、同じくアーチャー渾身の一撃によって相殺された。
pages.jaRuby:
「くっ
！」

！」
一際高い剣戟。

自身に叩きつけるようなランサー渾身の一撃は、同じくアーチャー渾身の一撃によって相殺された。
pages.en:
“Kh—!”

“Ghh—!”

A clash rings out above all the rest.

Sparks scatter as both men are driven backward.

Lancer's full-force blow, delivered as though to smash through Archer himself, is canceled by a blow into which Archer has poured equal force.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ku!”
“Gu!”
The weapons clash harder than before.
The two spring apart in a shower of sparks.
The full-force attack by Lancer is nullified by the full-force attack by Archer.

pages.ja:
離れた距離は五メートル弱。
ランサーならば一息もかけずに攻め込めるその間合いで、
「
解せんな」
ぽつりと、青い槍兵が呟いた。
pages.jaRuby:

ランサーならば一息もかけずに攻め込めるその間合いで、

解せんな」
ぽつりと、青い槍兵が呟いた。
pages.en:
Barely five meters separate them.

For Lancer, it is a distance he could cross without drawing breath.

“—I don't understand.”

The blue spearman speaks almost to himself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
They are about five meters apart.
It is a distance Lancer can close in an instant.
“I don’t get it.”
The spearman in blue murmurs.

pages.ja:
「貴様、これだけの腕を持っていながらキャスターについたのか。貴様と凛ならば、キャスターになぞ後れはとるまい」
殺意こそ途絶えたものの、ランサーの構えには一分の隙もない。
それを前にして、アーチャーは口元をわずかに歪めた。
pages.jaRuby:
「貴様、これだけの腕を持っていながらキャスターについたのか。貴様と凛ならば、キャスターになぞ後れはとるまい」
殺意こそ途絶えたものの、ランサーの構えには一分の隙もない。
それを前にして、アーチャーは口元をわずかに歪めた。
pages.en:
“You possess such skill, yet you sided with Caster? You and Rin together should never have fallen behind the likes of her.”

His bloodlust has abated, but not the slightest opening enters his stance.

Facing him, Archer's mouth twists faintly.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You switched to Caster’s side even though you are this strong? You and Rin would’ve had no trouble with Caster.”
Lancer stops emitting murderous intent, but there’s no opening in his stance.
At that, Archer smiles a bit.

pages.ja:
「
驚いたな。何を言いだすかと思えば、まだそんな事を口にするのか。
ランサー、私は少しでも勝算の高い手段をとっただけだ。凛がどう思おうと、私はこれ以外の手段はないと判断した」
自信に満ちた声に罪悪感などない。

The knight in red shows no regret about betraying his master.

His fighting spirit roars up.
Even faced with this, the archer in red still smiles.

The bloodlust pouring from him dwarfs anything he has shown before.

Within that suffocating tension—

The blue spearman's voice could drive even the crows from a battlefield.

His murderous intent is incomparable to his previous ones.

The blue-armored spearman growls in a voice that could drive the crows from a battlefield.

For this was a Noble Phantasm made from the first to be thrown.

A spear that must pierce the heart once it has taken aim.

A cursed Noble Phantasm that cannot be escaped, that hunts its target anew no matter how often it is evaded.

This is Gae Bolg, the spear of ruin borne by the hero who never once knew defeat in life.

Launched with the whole of Lancer's magical energy, it permits no defense. It cannot be evaded. It cannot be stopped.

…This Noble Phantasm is a throwing attack by nature.
A lance that never misses the heart.
A cursed Noble Phantasm that cannot be avoided and will attack the enemy even if it misses.
That is Gae Bolg, lance of destruction possessed by the hero that never lost in his lifetime.

Therefore, it is fatal.
There is no way for anyone to survive once they are targeted by the demonic lance…!!

pages.en:
Spear and shield collide.

The spear of death penetrates every evasion and every wall.

And here, it is stopped.

Leaving a storm and searing heat strewn in its wake, the fatal spear is held at bay by Archer's Noble Phantasm.

Seven petals appearing from nowhere shelter Archer, defying the crimson missile that would pierce their master—!

Who could have known?

This defense is Aias: the shield said to have been the only one to stop the great hero's throw in the Trojan War.

Its flower has seven petals, each the equal of an ancient fortress wall.

It is a defensive Noble Phantasm deemed invincible against thrown armaments—weapons released from the hands of their bearers.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The lance crashes into the shield.
The lance of death that penetrates every wall and outmaneuvers any evasion.
That lance has been stopped.
Radiating a storm of heat, the lance of sure kill is stopped by Archer’s “Noble Phantasm”.
The seven flower petals appear from empty space and shield Archer from the demonic bullet!
Who would know?
This shield is Aias. The only shield said to have repelled the javelin of the great hero in the Trojan War.
There are seven barriers shaped like flower petals, and each layer is as strong as a castle wall.

pages.en:
Before this shield, any thrown spear should inevitably have been defeated without piercing even a single petal.

At least, to Archer's knowledge, no spear capable of breaking through this defense could exist.
pages.mirrorMoon:
A thrown lance will be defeated by this shield without penetrating even one of the petals.
At the very least, Archer does not know of a lance that can penetrate this shield.

And yet—

The fatal spear drives through it as though meeting no resistance at all.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But.
The lance of sure kill drills through the shields like it’s nothing.

「
っ…………！！！！！」
六枚目の花弁が四散する。
残るは一枚。
魔槍は決して貫けなかったと言われる七枚目に到達し、なおその勢いを緩めない。

pages.en:
“—Ghh…………!”

The sixth petal bursts apart.

Only one remains.

The demonic spear reaches the seventh petal—the one said never to have been pierced—and still does not slacken.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……!!!!!”
The sixth petal is destroyed.
Only one remains.
The demonic lance reaches the seventh layer that has never been broken.

それを直前にし、

ぬああああああああ…………！！！！」

！

pages.en:
One final thorn of the demonic spear, its power not yet spent.

With it poised directly before him—

“Ngh—aaaaaaaagh…………!”

Archer pours every last measure of magical energy into his Noble Phantasm with a cry that rends the air—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
The unstoppable thorn of the demonic lance.
In the face of that power…
“NuNuaaaaaaaaaaaaaa……!!!!”
With a roaring spirit, Archer puts all his magical energy into the Noble Phantasm!

苦痛に歪む貌は腕の傷だけでなく、想像を絶する頭痛に耐えてのものだった。

pages.en:
“——”

Back upon the ground, Lancer can only stare at the Servant before him.

…Archer is battered beyond recognition.

The arm he thrust forward hangs like dead wood.

His face is contorted not only by the agony of that wound, but by an unimaginable pain within his skull.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
After landing, Lancer glares at the Servant in front of him.
…Archer has wounds all over his body.
His raised arm is
barely attached.
like a rotten branch.
His face is strained in pain, not only from the wounds on the arm, but also from the agony in his head.

「
驚いたな。アイアスを貫通しうる槍がこの世にあろうとは。
君のそれは、オリジナルの“大神宣言”を上回っている」
赤い騎士は心から青い槍兵に賛辞を送る。

pages.en:
“—I'm astonished. I never imagined a spear existed in this world that could pierce Aias.

“Yours surpasses even Gungnir, with which the great god made his declaration.”

The knight in red offers the blue spearman his praise without reservation.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I’m surprised. I did not think there was a weapon that could penetrate the Aias.
Your lance is stronger than the original Gungnir.”
The knight in red praises the spearman in blue from the bottom of his heart.

」

最強の一撃。
自らを英雄たらしめていた一撃を防がれたのだ。
その憤怒たるや、視線だけで人を呪い殺せよう。

pages.en:
“——”

No such praise could possibly reach Lancer.

His strongest blow—the blow that made him a hero—has been stopped.

His fury is such that his gaze alone might curse a man to death.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
But Lancer does not hear him.
His strongest attack.
The attack that made him a hero has been blocked.
He is so angry that his glare should be able to kill someone.

pages.ja:
だが、その怒りも強い疑問にうち消されつつあった。
……解せないどころの話ではない。
確かにアーチャーは正体不明のサーヴァントだ。
何処の英雄とも知れず、弓兵でありながら双剣を持ち、そして今、ランサー最強の一撃を防ぐほどの盾さえ見せた。
それは、異常だ。
そのような英雄、この世のどこを探しても見あたるまい。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Yet even that fury is slowly swallowed by a greater bewilderment.

…This is beyond mere confusion now.

Archer is undeniably a Servant of unknown identity. No one knows what hero he might be; despite being a bowman, he wields twin swords—and now he has produced a shield capable of stopping Lancer's mightiest attack.

It is unnatural.

No hero such as this could be found anywhere in the world.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But the anger is almost erased by his wonder.
…This is too strange.
It is true that Archer is a mysterious Servant.
His identity is unknown, he carries twin swords even though he’s an archer, and now he shows a shield that can even block Lancer’s strongest attack.
It is absurd.
There is no such hero on this planet.

「貴様
何者だ」
「ただの弓兵だが。君の見立ては間違いではない」
「戯れ言を。弓兵が宝具を防ぐほどの盾を持つものか」
「場合によっては持つだろう。
だが、それもこの様だ。魔力の大部分を消費したというのに腕をやられ、アイアスも完全に破壊された。
……まったく、私が持ち得る最強の守りだったのだがな、今のは」

pages.en:
“You—what are you?”

“Merely a bowman. Your assessment was not mistaken.”

“Spare me your nonsense. What bowman carries a shield capable of stopping a Noble Phantasm?”

“One might, depending upon the circumstances.

“Yet you see what it has cost me. I spent the greater part of my magical energy, lost the use of an arm, and Aias was destroyed completely.

“…That was the strongest defense at my disposal.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Who are you?”
“I’m just an archer. Your analysis was not incorrect.”
“Bullshit. An archer would not have a shield to block a Noble Phantasm.”
“I guess you can, under the right circumstances.
But this is the result. I used up most of my magical energy, one of my arms is destroyed, and Aias is shattered.
…Man, that was the greatest protection I had.”

pages.en:
“——”

Lancer can only continue glaring as Archer speaks so lightly.

Then—

“More importantly, have you noticed, Lancer?

“Caster appears to be having rather more difficulty than she expected. Her watch over us has ceased.”

Archer adds this with both hands raised as though in surrender.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
Lancer only glares at Archer.
Then.
“More importantly, have you noticed, Lancer?
It seems Caster is in trouble. She is no longer supervising us.”
Archer raises both his hands as if in surrender.

pages.en:
“…I see. I suspected as much. So that was your game from the beginning.”

“Naturally. I told you: I choose only the course with the greatest chance of victory.”

“—Hmph. You really are a bastard I can't stand, right to the bitter end.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I see. I knew it. That was your intention from the start, huh?”
“Of course. I told you, right? I will only take the route with the greatest chance of success.”
“Heh. I really do hate you.”

pages.ja:
苦々しげに言って、ランサーはアーチャーに背を向ける。
……彼の仕事は終った。
アーチャーを引きつけるという役割は、もはや意味をなさない。
これ以上、遠坂凛に肩入れする必要はなくなった。

pages.en:
Lancer spits the words bitterly and turns his back upon Archer.

…His work is done.

His role was to keep Archer occupied, and it no longer serves any purpose.

He has no further reason to lend Rin Tohsaka his aid.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saying so, Lancer turns his back to Archer.
…His work is done.
His role of keeping Archer busy is meaningless now.
There is no more need for him to side with Tohsaka Rin.
